ceiling_scope: all executions under this authorization, not per cell or retry
initial_execution_policy: small bounded transport smoke before comparative execution
accounting_policy: Unknown is not zero. Cached and reasoning subtokens must not be added twice to inclusive totals. Missing usage cannot refund a conservative reservation.
served_model_attestation: Upstream-reported names are observations, not independent proof of served model identity.
security_policy: Gateway access only through a trusted transport. Solver containers retain direct-network denial. Existing HTTPS upstream TLS verification must not be disabled.
